summary: Exclude repaired originals from actual-state values and runtime authority

replay.detail: Actual-state, provenance, origin and runtime-epoch readers apply repaired-ID membership directly; no replay is required to correct their output.

schema.detail: Readers use the existing primary-key repaired-ID set maintained by authenticated repairs. No new table, index or migration.

rules.detail: No admission, checkpoint or retention rule change. Actual-state readers now honor the existing repair retirement meaning, including after local receipt cleanup.

compatibility.detail: A physically retained repaired original no longer supplies actual fields, provenance, runtime authority or a runtime epoch. Single and batched readers select surviving claims identically. Response and wire formats are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No new synchronous startup work or index installation.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual SQL is required.

recovery.detail: The durable repaired-ID set survives receipt cleanup, rollback and registry rebuilds. Readers do not revive retired originals when admission receipts are absent.
